verdict.rationale: Luma documents reusable automations (Luma Skills, "Build a Creative Workflow Once, Run It Forever", and Luma Agents for multi-step workflows), so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows users can version, review, or roll back those workflows. The only versioning evidence covers the vendor's own /v1 API changelog and X-API-Version header, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
